summary: Songololo territory (Kongo-Central) lies between Kinshasa and Matadi along the RN1 road and railway, far from the eastern conflict zones; no armed group holds territory. Kimpese town, Songololo town, the Matadi suburbs in Nsona-Mpangu and rural villages are under ordinary state control, with the PNC as the main force keeping order and FARDC/border elements present along the corridor and the Angolan border (Lufu). Security issues are crime, cross-border trafficking and historically Bundu dia Kongo-related unrest (2017-2020), none amounting to territorial control. Web research was unavailable for this run, so all zones rest on default state presence.

zones.description: Kimpese town (cité) and its health-area neighbourhoods (Kimbanguiste, Yanga dia Songa, Kimbala, CBCO, CECO)
zones.evidence: Largest town of Songololo territory on the Kinshasa-Matadi road (RN1) and railway; no armed group holds territory in Kongo-Central. Order is kept by the PNC commissariat, with FARDC elements present along the corridor. Crime and past Bundu dia Kongo unrest (2017-2020) did not displace state control.
